//: REWRITES, NOT REDIRECTS. A redirect would send the browser to autoblog.ink
and change the address bar, which loses the SEO benefit of hosting the blog
on our own domain. A rewrite makes Vercel fetch the content server-side and
serve it AS belterai.app, so the visitor only ever sees belterai.app/blog.
Order matters: the bare /blog must come before the wildcard, or /blog/:path*
SECURITY NOTE: everything under /blog is same-origin with the rest of
belterai.app, so scripts in that third-party content can read and write
cookies and localStorage for this domain. That is inherent to proxying
someone else's site onto your own origin — don't put anything sensitive on
this domain while that is true.
This file is ignored by GitHub Pages, so it is safe to commit before the
migration; it does nothing until Vercel serves the domain.
